module: present_windows provider — disk resolve + attach + online + fail-closed safety classification (NON-destructive)
status: P0 rev6 2026-07-27 (folded Codex P2 r1-r5 — canonical VOLUME bearer model + named required fields); awaiting Codex P2 r6
goal: Extend applications/windows_disk_manager/tasks/present_windows.yml from the WDM-01 guard-only stub into the FIRST provider stage: assert every entry has a usable literal unique_id (AWS function deferred), resolve each to its attached disk, bring it online+writable, re-read facts, classify observed state with a FAIL-CLOSED positive-predicate classifier, and assert each is SAFE to provision-or-adopt (PRISTINE or OURS) with unambiguous identity. NO disk mutation beyond the idempotent online/writable fixup. Still fail-closed at the end (mutation deferred to WDM-02b) so a non-empty disks list cannot silent-green.
why: Director-approved WDM-02 decomposition (2026-07-27): 02a is the non-destructive safety foundation before any destructive mutation. Mirrors linux_disk_manager present_redhat's foreign-layout guard + the windows-wsus C02 pipeline, but with a STRONGER fail-closed classifier per the Director's 2026-07-27 middle-path decision (windows_disk_manager is a GENERIC framework role with no guaranteed-blank baseline, unlike the windows-wsus role).
blankSafetyDecision: Director 2026-07-27 MIDDLE PATH: classify fail-closed with a POSITIVE predicate + an explicit UNKNOWN state; do NOT add raw-sector signature scanning / BitLocker / Storage-Spaces probing (the over-engineering rejected in windows-wsus RESTART §8). A truly-RAW-no-signature disk that secretly held foreign data is an accepted, DOCUMENTED residual risk — a mis-targeted unique_id is an operator/CI input error, covered by reviewed config, not something the role deep-scans for.

contract.scope: VMware Phase-1 literal unique_id path only. An entry declaring `function` (AWS) or otherwise lacking a usable literal unique_id is asserted-and-failed BEFORE any resolve/online/mutation (Codex P2 r1 #7) — a dedicated 'every entry has a literal unique_id' assert runs first; a function entry fails with 'AWS function resolution not yet implemented (deferred)'. An undefined/empty unique_id must never become an empty-string match nor be filtered out of the online command.
contract.classification: CANONICAL BEARER MODEL (Codex P2 r5 #1): filesystem bearers are VOLUME records only (community.windows.win_disk_facts volumes[], each with fields `file_system` and `label`); a partition with no corresponding volume is UNFORMATTED (bears no filesystem). Counting is over VOLUMES, never partitions — a partition and its volume for the same filesystem count ONCE (as the volume). 'ALLOWLISTED VOLUME' = a volume whose `file_system` (normalized UPPERCASE) is in {NTFS, FAT, FAT32, EXFAT, REFS}. A null/empty `file_system` = an UNFORMATTED volume (neither allowlisted nor 'unrecognized'). A NON-EMPTY `file_system` not in the allowlist = UNRECOGNIZED. REQUIRED FIELDS (Codex P2 r5 #2): the physical disk MUST have `partition_style`; every present volume record MUST have `file_system`. Classify FAIL-CLOSED, UNKNOWN-precedence, from POST-ONLINE facts: STEP 0 (completeness/contradiction gate FIRST -> UNKNOWN + REFUSE): `partition_style` missing; any present volume record missing `file_system`; any volume with a NON-EMPTY UNRECOGNIZED `file_system`; OR `partition_style`==RAW WITH any present partition OR volume record (contradictory). RAW with absent/empty partitions AND volumes collections is VALID (not UNKNOWN). STEP 1 (complete, non-contradictory facts), by precedence: OURS = EXACTLY ONE allowlisted volume, AND that volume's `file_system`==NTFS AND its `label`==the entry's label CASE-INSENSITIVELY. PRISTINE = `partition_style`==RAW AND no partitions AND no volumes. FOREIGN = everything else (fail-closed default): the single allowlisted volume is NTFS but a non-matching label, an allowlisted non-NTFS volume (FAT/FAT32/exFAT/ReFS), MORE THAN ONE allowlisted volume (mixed), or a non-RAW disk whose only volumes are unformatted (empty fs). Safe-to-provision-or-adopt = state in [PRISTINE, OURS]; UNKNOWN and FOREIGN both REFUSE.
contract.identity: unique_id SELECTS, label CONFIRMS. Each unique_id matches EXACTLY ONE attached disk (asserted early so the online loop's Get-Disk lookup cannot silently skip a missing disk — Codex P2 r1 #5); matched disk numbers DISTINCT across entries.

No mutation beyond the online fixup.

windows-wsus wsus/present_windows.yml C02 (lines ~99-205): win_disk_facts(physical_disk,partitions,volumes) -> attach assert (matches==1) -> online+writable win_shell (clear IsReadOnly THEN IsOffline; idempotent) -> re-load facts -> 'Safe To Provision Or Adopt' (observed in pristine/unformatted/ours) -> 'Unambiguous' (distinct numbers). RESTART §6 (windows-wsus): OFFLINE disk enumerates NO partitions -> online BEFORE classify, clear read-only BEFORE online; win_disk_facts unique_id='eui.<hex>'; NTFS label is the durable 'ours' recognizer; unformatted volume type is EMPTY STRING; RAW disk has no 'volumes' key. RESTART §8: do NOT over-engineer emptiness gates (no raw-sector/BitLocker scanning).
invariants: NON-DESTRUCTIVE: only state change is the idempotent online/writable fixup on DECLARED disks. NO win_initialize_disk/win_partition/win_format.
AWS/function + missing-unique_id entries fail closed BEFORE any resolve/online (Codex P2 r1 #7). No undefined ID reaches Get-Disk as an empty match.

Classifier is FAIL-CLOSED, UNKNOWN-precedence, DETERMINISTIC over a CANONICAL VOLUME bearer model (Codex P2 r1-r5): bearers are win_disk_facts VOLUME records (file_system+label); count VOLUMES not partitions. STEP 0 -> UNKNOWN: missing disk.partition_style, a volume missing file_system, a non-empty unrecognized file_system, or RAW-with-any-present-partition/volume. STEP 1: OURS = exactly one allowlisted volume that is NTFS + case-insensitive matching label; PRISTINE = RAW + no partitions + no volumes; else FOREIGN. Allowlist {NTFS,FAT,FAT32,EXFAT,REFS}; empty file_system = unformatted. NO raw-sector/BitLocker scanning (Director middle path).
Terminal fail-closed is guarded `when: config.disks | length > 0` — a non-empty list cannot silent-green; an EMPTY list greens (vendor assert only), regression of WDM-01 (Codex P2 r1 #6).
Exactly-one-attached asserted BEFORE the online loop so a missing disk cannot be silently skipped (Codex P2 r1 #5); matched disk numbers distinct.

online-fixup win_shell: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Get-Disk + both Set-Disk under terminating errors; NEVER reports 'changed' after a failed transition; changed_when accepts ONLY the exact 'changed' sentinel; disk ids passed via environment (NOT interpolated into PS source); passes check-winshell-splitargs.py (Codex P2 r1 #9-10).
